originalTitle: Flydubai passenger describes putting attacker in chokehold after cockpit stabbing
summary: Other passengers on the Israel-bound flight described the "terrifying" moment the plane dropped.
content:
Passengers on a flight to Israel have recounted how they subdued a pilot after he stabbed the other pilot and appeared to be trying to disable the plane, while others described the "terrifying" moment they thought they would die.

Appearing in a bloodstained shirt after the ordeal, Yaniv Hayun told Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu he realised something was wrong when the aircraft suddenly dropped.

The plane, en route from Dubai to Tel Aviv, plummeted 17,000ft (5,200m) in less than two minutes.

"Someone screamed... the light went out," Hayun said in a video posted by the prime minister on social media.

He and others tried to push open the cockpit door, but the pilot who had been stabbed was very close to it, so it was hard to open. Before he collapsed, the injured pilot managed to open the door.

When Hayun and another man entered the cockpit, he said he saw one pilot down and the attacker on the instruments, between the two seats, "trying to destroy the instruments in order to...disable the plane".

"I grabbed the attacker, put him in a chokehold, and pulled him - first and foremost - outside," Hayun said.

"We pulled him out; it was a matter of seconds. I called out to the Israeli guys with us on the plane - I called them, and two other guys came over to me... we pinned [the attacker] down to keep him secure."

'I pulled the controls': Passenger tells Israeli PM how he helped stop attacker

Hayun said he then jumped back into the cockpit and "started pulling the controls".

When asked by Netanyahu whether he knew what he was doing, the passenger answered: "I watch Air Crash Investigation, Mr Prime Minister."

Hayun said the plane then started to level out. By then, two on-duty pilots who had been in the passenger cabin were at the front of the plane, and one told Hayun he was taking control from there.

Netanyahu praised Hayun, calling him a "great hero" and a "lion".

Another passenger, Zvika Meness, told Israeli public broadcaster Kan he helped overpower the attacker, and the passenger and two others "tied him up with his own zip ties and with the multimedia headphones".

"Another pilot who was sitting in the passenger cabin went in to replace the additional pilot, and they essentially landed the plane," he added.

The Flydubai flight eventually landed at Tabuk airport in northwestern Saudi Arabia, and the passengers were later taken to Tel Aviv's Ben Gurion airport on a repatriation aircraft.

They were greeted by crowds of onlookers playing music, singing, dancing and waving Israeli flags.

"Thank God I'm alive," passenger Haim Lazarovich told journalists, adding that "the most terrifying moment in this flight was when the pilot loses control".

Oran Choen, an 18-year-old passenger, described the incident as "a very tough moment".

"Maybe it was five minutes, but it feels like hell - I heard my brother behind me scream that we was going to die," he added.

A paramedic from Israel's ambulance service later told the BBC that a number of people were "very emotional and crying as they came off the plane".

The stabbed pilot, Indian national Captain Smit Machchhar, was taken to hospital but is in stable condition, according to the Indian embassy in Saudi Arabia.

Netanyahu praised Machchhar as a "true hero" of "extraordinary bravery".

The attacker was arrested and is being questioned by Saudi authorities.

Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz has called it an "attempted jihadist terror attack". No official motive for the incident or further information has been given.

US President Donald Trump said he had spoken with Netanyahu following the incident, saying it seemed as though the attacker was "perhaps a terrorist" or there were other reasons behind the attack.

chineseTitle: 迪拜航空乘客描述在驾驶舱刺伤后将袭击者掐住脖子
chineseSummary: 飞往以色列的航班上的其他乘客描述了飞机坠落的“可怕”时刻。
chineseContent:
飞往以色列的航班上的乘客讲述了他们如何在一名飞行员刺伤另一名飞行员后制服了另一名飞行员，并且似乎试图让飞机瘫痪，而其他人则描述了他们认为自己会死的“可怕”时刻。

经历磨难后，亚尼夫·哈云 (Yaniv Hayun) 身穿血迹斑斑的衬衫现身，他告诉以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡 (Benjamin Netanyahu)，当飞机突然坠落时，他意识到出了问题。

这架飞机在从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的途中，不到两分钟就从 17,000 英尺（5,200m）的高度坠落。

“有人尖叫……灯灭了，”哈云在总理在社交媒体上发布的视频中说道。

他和其他人试图推开驾驶舱门，但被刺伤的飞行员离舱门很近，很难打开。在倒下之前，受伤的飞行员设法打开了舱门。

当哈云和另一名男子进入驾驶舱时，他说他看到一名飞行员倒下，袭击者在两个座位之间的仪器上，“试图摧毁仪器，以便……使飞机瘫痪”。

海云说：“我抓住了袭击者，掐住了他的脖子，然后把他拉到了外面。”

“我们把他拉了出来；只用了几秒钟的时间。我向飞机上的以色列人喊话——我打电话给他们，另外两个人过来找我……我们按住了[袭击者]以保证他的安全。”

“我拉开了控制装置”：乘客告诉以色列总理他如何帮助阻止袭击者

海云说，他随后跳回驾驶舱并“开始拉动控制装置”。

当内塔尼亚胡问他是否知道自己在做什么时，这名乘客回答说：“我看空难调查，总理先生。”

海云说，飞机随后开始保持平稳。当时，两名在客舱内的值班飞行员位于飞机前部，其中一名告诉哈云，他正在那里控制飞机。

内塔尼亚胡盛赞哈云，称他是“伟大的英雄”和“狮子”。

另一位乘客兹维卡·梅内斯 (Zvika Meness) 告诉以色列公共广播公司坎，他帮助制服了袭击者，这名乘客和另外两人“用自己的拉链和多媒体耳机把他绑了起来”。

他补充说：“坐在客舱里的另一名飞行员取代了额外的飞行员，他们基本上使飞机着陆了。”

Flydubai航班最终降落在沙特阿拉伯西北部的塔布克机场，乘客随后被遣返飞机送往特拉维夫的本古里安机场。

他们受到一群演奏音乐、唱歌、跳舞并挥舞以色列国旗的围观者的欢迎。

“感谢上帝，我还活着，”乘客海姆·拉扎罗维奇告诉记者，并补充说“这次飞行中最可怕的时刻是飞行员失去控制的时候”。

18 岁的乘客奥兰·乔恩 (Oran Choen) 将这一事件描述为“一个非常艰难的时刻”。

“也许只有五分钟，但感觉就像地狱一样——我听到我身后的兄弟尖叫着我们快要死了，”他补充道。

以色列救护车服务部门的一名护理人员后来告诉英国广播公司，许多人“下飞机时非常情​​绪化并哭泣”。

据印度驻沙特阿拉伯大使馆称，被刺伤的飞行员是印度国家机长斯米特·马赫恰尔，已被送往医院，但情况稳定。

内塔尼亚胡称赞马赫恰尔是“非凡勇敢”的“真正英雄”。

袭击者已被捕，并正在接受沙特当局的审问。

以色列国防部长以色列·卡茨称这是一次“未遂的圣战恐怖袭击”。官方尚未给出该事件的动机或进一步信息。

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，事件发生后他已与内塔尼亚胡进行了交谈，称袭击者“可能是恐怖分子”，或者袭击背后还有其他原因。
